name: Advanced Language Selector
description: Provides an advanced language selector block.
project_description:
The Advanced Language Selector module is an advanced language switcher block for Drupal.

 You can put all advanced language selector block that you want in your site, simply go to

the admin block page (/admin/structure/block), select Advanced Language Selector Block,

configure it and save changes. That's all!

 Features 
 
 Insert language selector block 
 Customize the style of selector, for example, plain HTML or Bootstrap 
 Posibility of add new custom styles (comming soon) 
 And many more... 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 No additional modules are required.

 Recommended modules/libraries 
 This module provides an external bootstrap library integration, but the bootstrap styles works better using a bootstrap based theme. 

 Documentation 
 This module is very intuitive to use. Simply, add an Advanced Language Selector Block,

configure it and save changes.

 Be sure that your site is multilingual (enable language and translations modules). If your site is not multilingual, the component wont be displayed .
